notes: 02: metadata.js collects only title+description+source hostname; no favicon or preview image. 03: no way to edit auto-collected title/description; only refresh re-fetches, no manual edit. 04: only tag-add works (addLabel); url/title/description/note not editable and tags cannot be removed. 05: no delete endpoint or UI anywhere. 07: cards show title/description/tags but use a first-letter site-mark, not a favicon. 10: label input has autocomplete='off' and no datalist/suggestions of existing tags. 12: matchesBookmark searches only title+description, not url or note. 14: no #tag search parsing. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase handling; search is plain substring includes(). 18: only 'library'/'archive' views; no unread-only list/filter. 19: mark-as-read works but there is no unread list for it to remove items from. 20: no multi-select or bulk-action API/UI. 21: no filter-scoped bulk apply. 22: fixed updatedAt-desc order only; no user-selectable sort key. 23: no note field or markdown rendering. 24: no local HTML snapshot and no PDF rule. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 27: archive is reversible (restore) but delete does not exist, so the archive-vs-delete distinction is only half realised. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no Netscape HTML export. 32: no user settings (default sort, displayed items, font size).
